shell.home: Minos Studio, back to the workspaces

login.intro: Sign in with an API key with scope {manage} or {admin}.
login.noManagement: This installation has no Management API (no database): use the demo.
login.noDatabase: No database? Open the {demo} with the Aurora examples.
login.passwordIntro: Sign in with your e-mail address and password: any address of your account works.
login.tooMany: Too many failed attempts for this address: try again later.
login.useApiKey: Sign in with an API key
login.usePassword: Sign in with e-mail and password

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.slugHint: Used in the API URLs. Requires an admin key.
workspaces.empty: No workspaces yet. Create one to get started.

workspace.title: Workspace {ws}
workspace.entityHint: The entity schema guides the editor
workspace.importInvalid: The file is not valid JSON
workspace.noRulesets: No rule sets: create one after defining an entity.
workspace.importOverwrite: Rule set {ruleset} already exists here: importing replaces its draft and the {count} tests of the bundle with the same names. Continue?
workspace.importDependencies: Imported. The rule set uses these sub rule sets, which must be imported and published here too: {list}
workspace.accessIntro: The organization's owners and admins are always admins; give the other members a role here.

entity.title: Entity {entity}
entity.samples: Samples (an object or a list of objects)
entity.samplesHint: More samples make optional the fields that do not appear everywhere.
entity.composeHint: Fields whose type is another entity: a rule set on this entity reads every part directly ($.input.<field>...). Fields that are not entities stay as they are.
entity.jsonSchemaHint: Another entity as the type of a field: {"$ref": "entity:Course"}, pinned to its latest version when saved.

demo.runFailed: Execution failed ({message}). Start the API: cd backend && uv run uvicorn minos.api.app:app
demo.hint: Select a node to see its configuration, or press Simulate to run the rule set on the chosen input.

editor.unsavedConfirm: There are unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
editor.layoutHint: Arranges the nodes left to right following the connections
editor.exportHint: Download the draft with schema and tests, to import elsewhere
editor.conflict: Someone else changed the draft. Reload to see the updated version (your changes will be lost).
editor.emptyHint: Drag a node from the palette onto the canvas, connect outputs to inputs and select a node to configure it.
editor.validateFailed: Draft saved, but it could not be validated: {error}
editor.readOnly: You are {role} in this workspace: you can read, validate and simulate, not edit.

canvas.paletteHint: {description}. Drag onto the canvas or click to add.

graph.startExists: the graph already has a start node
graph.selfLoop: a node cannot connect to itself
graph.intoStart: the start node cannot have incoming connections
graph.cycle: the connection would create a cycle

expression.onlyMatching: Only the elements that satisfy a condition
expression.useSelect: Use a value computed from each element

node.affectedFieldHint: For the forms of calling systems, e.g. courses
node.onFailHint: The fail branch, when connected, is always followed
node.switchHint: The first true branch wins; if none is true, "default" is followed.
node.label: Label
node.startHint: The entry point: connect its output to the first check.
node.varsHint: Available in the other nodes as $.vars.name.
node.onlyWhen: Only when a condition is true
node.outcomeHint: A valid outcome becomes invalid if errors were emitted

table.help: Cells: empty = any · {c1} · {c2} (one of) · {c3} · {c4} · {c5} · {c6} · {c7}. If no row applies, the node exits through {fail}.

subruleset.forEach: Run for each element of a list
subruleset.passAny: At least one element is valid
subruleset.otherItemInput: Pass a value other than the element
subruleset.otherInput: Pass a value other than the input object
subruleset.targetHint: Outcome and output of the sub rule set, in $.vars
subruleset.help: The messages of the sub rule set appear in the result with their originating node; the node exits through {fail} if the rule set is not valid.

simulate.loadTest: Load the input of a test
simulate.selectNode: Select a node to see its input and output.
simulate.saveAsTest: Save this simulation as a test
simulate.saveAsTestHint: The current outcome, message codes and output become the expected result.
simulate.staleResult: The rule set changed after this simulation: run it again to save it as a test.

tests.intro: Tests run on every publication: if one fails, the version is not created.
tests.run: Run the tests on the draft
tests.empty: No tests. Save a simulation as a test from the Simulation tab.

versions.publishIntro: The draft is compiled, checked against the schema and verified with all the tests.
versions.environmentsHint: Each call uses the version in force on its reference date: you can schedule the rules of a period (e.g. from 1 August) while the current ones stay active.
versions.now: Right away, with no start date (replaces the current version)
versions.fromDate: From a date: calls with a later reference date will use this version
versions.unchanged: Nothing changed since version {version}: no new version was published.

diff.title: From {from} to the draft
diff.identical: No differences in the rules (positions on the canvas do not count).

settings.modeHint: Collecting all errors suits forms; stopping at the first suits blocking checks.
settings.constantsHint: Configuration values reused by the rules: thresholds, dates, price lists.

api.edgeToStart: edges cannot point to the start node
api.uniqueViolated: hit policy 'unique' violated: rows {rows} all match

api.opAtLeastTwo: operator {op} needs at least two operands
api.regexLiteral: regex pattern must be a literal string

api.coalesceArgs: coalesce needs at least one argument

api.notInSchema: {path} does not exist in the entity schema
api.notInElement: {path} does not exist in the array element schema
api.unknownVariable: variable {name} is neither a constant nor assigned
api.compareAlways: '{op}' compares {field} with a {type} literal: it is always {always}
api.schemaObject: a schema must be a JSON object
api.schemaDialect: only JSON Schema draft 2020-12 is supported, got {dialect}
api.missingKey: missing API key: send 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' or 'X-Api-Key'
api.adminRequired: an admin API key is required
api.cannotExecute: the API key cannot execute in this workspace
api.keyScope: the API key lacks the {scope} scope
api.keyOtherWorkspace: the API key belongs to another workspace
api.bodyInput: body must be an object with an 'input' member
api.inputSchema: input does not match the entity schema
api.noDeployment: no deployment {target} for the reference date
api.traceValues: trace must be none, summary or full

orgs.choose: Your account belongs to several organizations: choose one. You can switch from the menu at the top.
orgs.none: Your account does not belong to any organization yet: ask an administrator for an invitation.

invite.asSignedIn: The address {email} will be added to your account ({account}): you will be able to sign in with either, with the same password.
invite.name: Full name
invite.existingAccount: This address already has an account: use its password.
invite.haveAccount: Already have an account with another address?

members.title: Members of {org}
members.orgRoleHint: Owners and admins manage members and workspaces and are admins of every workspace.
members.workspaceRolesHint: Viewer: reads and simulates. Author: edits. Publisher: publishes and moves environments (prod included). Admin: API keys, members, audit.
members.linkIntro: Send this link to {email}: Minos sends no e-mail. It works once and is shown only now.
